summary.headline: Sky Gold Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue rose 78% YoY to INR2,013 crores, with gross margin at 9.3% and operating cash flow of about INR30 crores.
summary.overview: Consolidated revenue for Q1 FY27 was INR2,013 crores, up 78% YoY, implying an annualised run rate near the FY27 guidance of INR8,100 crores. Gross margin rose to 9.3% from 9.1% in Q4 FY26, driven by a higher share of non-22KT jewellery and studded products. EBITDA was INR157 crores (7.8% margin) and operating PAT crossed INR100 crores for the first time. Operating cash flow turned positive at about INR30 crores, and working capital days edged up to 60 from 59 in March. Management said it will revise FY27 guidance only after Diwali.

financial_highlights.value: Crossed INR100 crores for the first time

financial_highlights.change: Positive vs negative operating cash flow through FY26
QoQ/as stated by CFO; company no longer gives volume guidance

segments.name: Advance Gold model
segments.commentary: Advance Gold share of sales reached 17% in Q1 vs 20% in Q4 FY26 (management says volumes flat, share diluted by higher total volume); contributes about 90-100 bps to revenue and gross margin. Internal FY27 target was 15%.

segments.name: Non-22KT jewellery (18KT, 14KT, 9KT)
segments.commentary: Share rose to 14% of volume from 10.5% in Q4 FY26, contributing about 1.4-1.5% to gross margin.

segments.name: Studded jewellery (natural and lab-grown)
segments.commentary: Share rose to 2.1% of revenue from 1.65% in Q4 FY26, contributing about 0.3% to gross margin. Natural diamonds are about 2% of business.

segments.name: 22KT jewellery
segments.commentary: Gross margin about 6-6.5%; roughly 70% of this is CZ-studded (margin not stated separately), with plain gold at 5-5.5% margin.

segments.name: Exports
segments.commentary: Export share rose to close to 18% from about 14.5% in Q4 FY26. UAE 6%, Singapore 2%, Malaysia 2% of sales; UK/Europe pipeline of INR30-45 crores, initial UK order of 25-30 kg.

guidance_outlook: FY27 revenue target of INR8,100 crores; management to revise after Diwali (after one more quarter).
FY30 revenue aspiration of INR18,000-19,000 crores, excluding Advance Gold business revenue; PAT target of INR1,000 crores over time.
Gross margin guidance of 8.5-9% blended; PAT margin long-term guidance of about 5.25%.
Operating cash flow to PAT conversion target of close to 20%; revenue growth of 30-35% per year cited for the Sky Gold 3.0 horizon.
Net working capital cycle: reduce by about 2 days YoY, target 52 days by 2030; net debt-free by 2030.
Advance Gold targets: 15% average in FY27, 20% in FY28, 25% in FY29, 30% by 2030. Exports targeted at 20% of sales in coming years.
Zero-salary promoter compensation from FY27; promoter pay linked to dividends paid from operating cash flow, after debt reduction.
capex_capacity: Current capacity utilisation about 60% (stated range 55-57% earlier in the call), against 1.2 tons capacity; management expects utilisation to rise 7-8% QoQ.
Asset-light model: capacity sufficient until 2028. Post-2028 expansion planned on a leased basis, with 120-day lead time to take capacity from 1.2 to 1.10-2.4 tons.
Expansion capex of INR75-100 crores (machinery, furniture and fixtures), about 12-20% of PAT; rent-free period of around 120 days typically available.
Company has 4 facilities; no acquisitions on the table.
demand_pricing: Shift to lower-karat jewellery driven by customer preference and high gold prices; 18KT, 14KT and 9KT gaining share.
Management says gold price volatility has squeezed margins across peers, but Sky Gold maintained margin via back-to-back hedging.
Gen Z brands (CaratLane, Candere, GIVA) growing; 4 large corporates onboarded in 15-18 months, faster than the 24-36 months expected.
Industry organisation: B2C about 40% organised; B2B about 20% organised; management expects 75% organised by 2030.
Seasonality: Q2 (Navratri-Diwali) above Q1; Q3 (wedding season) above Q2; Q4 (March, Akshaya Tritiya deliveries) strongest per management.

qa_highlights.question: Given the Q1 run rate, should FY27 guidance be revised upward?
qa_highlights.answer: Management will revise guidance after Diwali; revenue upgrades depend on a greater share of studded and Advance Gold business.

qa_highlights.question: Why did inventory/working capital days rise QoQ?
qa_highlights.answer: Working capital days moved from 59 to 60. Cash is being redeployed into higher-margin studded jewellery, which needs slightly more working capital; exports rose to about 18%.

qa_highlights.question: Is the rise in payable days sustainable?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said gold credit is nearly nil while diamond purchases get market-standard credit, so the higher payables are sustainable. Each 1-day change in operating cycle is worth about INR95 crores of operating cash.

qa_highlights.question: Net debt level?
qa_highlights.answer: Net debt was INR540 crores at quarter end.

qa_highlights.question: Capacity utilisation and capex plans?
qa_highlights.answer: Utilisation is about 60% (55-65% range across standalone and subsidiaries); capacity lasts until 2028, then leased expansion with capex of INR80-100 crores.

qa_highlights.question: Will FY28 growth guidance be given?
qa_highlights.answer: Management expects 30-35% sales growth under Sky Gold 3.0 and plans to give FY27/FY28 estimates after September.

qa_highlights.question: Why guide PAT margin at 5.25% and gross margin at 8.5-9% when mix is improving?
qa_highlights.answer: Guidance was set at end-2025 for a five-year horizon; volume discounts of 0.25-0.5% on large 22KT orders dilute margins. Management said guidance may be improved.

qa_highlights.question: Impact of the July 2026 fraud disclosure on Q2?
qa_highlights.answer: INR10.7 crores involved; about INR3.5 crores recovered, legal proceedings initiated and a favourable order obtained. Management declined further comment as the matter is under legal and investigative process.

risks_watch: Revenue guidance (INR8,100 crores FY27) to be revised only after Diwali; watch whether the upgrade comes and how much it depends on studded and Advance Gold mix.

Working capital days rose to 60 from 59 while payables rose; management says gold credit is nearly nil, so payable-led gains depend on diamond credit terms. Each 1-day change is about INR95 crores of operating cash.
Capacity utilisation about 60% against 1.2 tons; management expects 7-8% QoQ improvement. Capacity seen sufficient to 2028, then leased expansion with INR75-100 crores capex.
INR10.7 crore fraud disclosed in July 2026; about INR3.5 crores recovered, legal process ongoing, and management declined further comment, so Q2 impact is unquantified.
Guidance inconsistency: PAT margin of about 5.25% and gross margin of 8.5-9% were set in late 2025 and not raised, while management says mix is improving; watch for an upgrade.
Volume reporting: company has stopped giving volume guidance and no realisation per unit is disclosed, reducing visibility on the 7-9% volume growth claim.
key_quotes: So, we will revise our target after Diwali. We'll analyze one more quarter, and we will give our new guidance post Diwali. That's our plan.

I am pleased to report that during quarter, the company has generated approximately INR30 crores of operating cash flow, marking an important milestone in our journey towards building a stronger and more self-sufficient business model.
As the contribution from Advance Gold continues to increase, we expect working capital intensity of our business to moderate further, supporting stronger operating cash flow generation.
Again to close this expanding the facility is not an issue for us. We are not a factory which has long lead times. So, our key competitive advantage is design.
summary.management_tone: Confident on growth, margin and cash flow milestones, but cautious and deferential on guidance: management repeatedly deferred revisions to post-Diwali and declined to quantify realisation, karat-wise volumes or the fraud impact. Answers on utilisation and capex were occasionally inconsistent (55-57% vs 60%, 15-20% vs 12-15% capex to PAT).
